'''Virtual Block 8''' (Scoundrels) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The hub Date prefers the first subset: Virtual Set 8.1 Scoundrels ('''May 2012'''; exact day unknown; PC site carried 8.1 announcement/theme posts in April 2012; definitely out by '''29 June 2012''' per Rogue4/8.2 announce wording).<ref name="vb81">https://web.archive.org/web/20120510015711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/</ref> Later subsets: 8.2 Agents For Hire (20 September 2012); 8.3 A Wretched Hive (March 2013 window; Category One 19 March 2013 implies not yet released that day; primary PC day still missing).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
